parts.note_add: Mazda has discontinued every 79-85 steering box (Mazdatrix). Exchange rebuilds: Atkins Rotary ARE850 box-and-column, 750 USD + 150 core, out of stock; Advantage Steering SKU 70409, 1145 USD + 500 core, 3-year warranty. Atkins' listing gives the fill as 0.31 US qt (290 cc), which supports the 290 cc reading of S-038. Removal takes the bonnet off and the box out through the engine bay; Mazda's labour figure was 4 h. Figure: S-005 Engine-Chassis PDF p.94 (3210A-1).

Nut 40-50 N·m (S-038 T:7). Mark wheel and shaft before removal and pull with a puller; never hammer the column shaft end, it is collapsible and the blow damages the bearing (S-002 p.10A-5, 1985). Only used wheels are on the market (eBay). Figure: S-005 Engine-Chassis PDF p.93 (3200A-1).

The pad levers off the wheel (protect the spokes) and covers the horn contact set 8871-32-750 (S-005 EC-093, 4-spoke); the contact grounds the GL relay-coil wire through the column, so the wheel nut wrench sounds the horns unless the battery or the horn/stop 15 A fuse is out. Used only (eBay).
Atkins Rotary listed FA24-32-120 at 350 USD for 82-83 and 84-85 without power steering; NLA, out of stock. Housing-to-frame bolts 44-53 N·m with the alignment shim kept in place.
Serviced only as a unit: the 1985 manual says do not disassemble the worm shaft and ball nut, and to replace the whole gear if the nut does not run freely on the worm (S-002 p.10A-7).

No longer sold separately (about 200 USD when it was; jimrothe.com); an rx7club owner with two 1982 cars reports the sector shafts differ within the year at the tapered-roller bearing seat (early: removable bearing set, later: a lip). Bush clearance wear limit 0.1 mm; adjusting-screw end clearance 0-0.1 mm (S-038 T:6).
Lock nut 230-260 N·m (S-038 T:8); the end cover screws in to set worm bearing preload before the lock nut is tightened.
Side cover bolts 45-55 N·m with sealing agent (S-002 p.10A-8, 1985). The flathead adjusting screw is the weak part: hand-tight only, over-tightening stops return-to-centre (rx7club).
NLA from Mazda (Atkins Rotary); Atkins Rotary sells a rebuilt arm at 199.95 USD, out of stock. Nut 150-180 N·m on matched serrations; pulled with SST 49 0223 695E.

No new or reproduction centre link listed by Atkins Rotary or Mazdatrix. Joint nuts: pitman arm 30-45, idler arm 25-35, tie-rods 30-45 N·m, new split pins (S-038 T:7). Figure: S-005 Engine-Chassis PDF p.95 (3230A-1).

Recall campaign 17510 (1986-02-01) replaced the idler arm free on '79-'83 RX-7s in the road-salt states because the pin corrodes and seizes; a modified arm went into production from March 1983 - check for a replacement arm on the car. New arms: OEM 8871-32-320A NLA (Atkins 475 USD), Atkins aftermarket 99 USD NLA, Moog K9369 listed but reported unavailable; the usual repair is new bushes (PT490). Bracket bolts 44-55 N·m; revolving torque 20-60 N at 135 mm.

Atkins Rotary 10.75 USD each, in stock, two per car (replaces 0866-32-329C, 1524-32-329A); Mazdatrix 12.14 USD. Worn bushes show as up-and-down play and a clunk; pack with lithium NLGI No. 2 on assembly.

The adjuster stud between the two ball joints, M14x1.5 x 113.5 mm (Atkins Rotary, 19.95 USD, in stock; Mazdatrix 22.37 USD); jam nuts 9992-21-400 (inside) and 9994-41-400 (outside), lock nuts 70-80 N·m. Toe-in is reset by turning the studs equally.

Atkins Rotary's inner tie rod end 8531-32-240A 'replaces 8531-99-322A', so this set is the INNER joint (centre-link end) and 8021-99-324 (PT493) the outer - check against the figure. Atkins 95 USD in stock, Mazdatrix 84.28 USD; Moog ES2192R.

Atkins Rotary sells the outer (knuckle-arm) tie rod end as 8021-32-280, 59.25 USD, aftermarket to OEM spec since Mazda discontinued it; the 8021- prefix supports reading the index's B021-99-324 as 8021-99-324 and places this set at the knuckle arm. Moog ES2355. Sealed, no lubrication service.
Atkins Rotary lists the 8021-32-279 boot for 79-91 at 15.95 USD, out of stock. Fitted with installer 49 8038 785 after packing with lithium NLGI No. 2 grease (S-002 p.10A-12).

specs.item: Steering wheel free play, limit
specs.note: 1.57 in; the 5-20 mm standard is SP-109

specs.item: Backlash between rack and sector gear
specs.note: adjust to 0 mm at the centre of pitman-arm travel; the 1985 procedure (S-002 p.10A-10) sets it with a dial indicator on the pitman arm end

specs.item: Worm bearing preload, without sector shaft and column bush
specs.note: printed 1.7-4.3 in-lb; the 1985 manual states the same figure as 0.2-0.5 kg spring-scale pull at attachment 49 0180 510B on the column shaft end (S-002 p.10A-8)

specs.item: Worm bearing preload, with sector shaft and column bush
specs.note: printed 5.2-10.4 in-lb; the 1985 manual states 0.6-1.2 kg (1.32-2.65 lb) spring-scale pull, measured with the centre link disconnected (S-002 p.10A-9, 10A-10)

specs.item: Clearance between sector shaft and housing bush, wear limit
End clearance of adjusting screw and sector shaft
specs.note: 0-0.004 in; the screw sits in the side cover (PT481)

specs.item: Maximum wheel angle on full lock, inside wheel
specs.note: same figure in S-002 p.10A-3

specs.item: Maximum wheel angle on full lock, outside wheel
specs.note: same figure in S-002 p.10A-3

specs.item: Torque, steering gear housing to frame
specs.note: 32-40 ft-lb; four bolts 8173-32-359 (S-005 EC-094); keep the alignment shim between housing and frame in its original place (S-002 p.10A-9)

specs.item: Torque, steering gear box end cover lock nut
Torque, steering wheel nut
specs.note: 29-36 ft-lb

specs.item: Torque, pitman arm to sector shaft
specs.note: S-038 prints 15-18 N·m beside 108-130 ft-lb, a misprint; 108-130 ft-lb is 150-180 N·m and S-002 p.10A-9 and 10A-12 print 150-180 N·m (108-130 ft-lb). Align the identical serrations of arm and shaft

specs.item: Torque, pitman arm to center link
specs.note: 22-33 ft-lb, castle nut with new split pin (S-002 p.10A-12 gives the same)

specs.item: Torque, idler arm to center link
specs.note: 18-25 ft-lb, castle nut with new split pin (S-002 p.10A-11 gives the same)

specs.item: Torque, tie-rod to center link
specs.note: 22-33 ft-lb, castle nut with new split pin (S-002 p.10A-12 gives the same)

specs.item: Torque, tie-rod to knuckle arm
specs.note: 22-33 ft-lb, castle nut with new split pin; toe-in must be reset whenever a tie-rod or ball joint is replaced (S-002 p.10A-12)

specs.item: Torque, tie-rod lock nut
specs.note: 51-58 ft-lb; the two jam nuts on the adjuster stud (S-002 p.10A-13 figure: lock nut 70-80 N·m, turn the tie-rod toward the arrow to lengthen); Atkins sells the inside and outside nuts as different parts, 9992-21-400 and 9994-41-400

specs.item: Knuckle arm ball stud revolving torque, minimum
specs.note: printed 'more than 4 N (14 oz)'; the outer tie-rod ball joint at the knuckle arm

specs.item: Torque, idler arm bracket to frame
specs.note: 32-40 ft-lb (S-002 p.10A-11 gives the same)

specs.item: Idler arm revolving torque
specs.note: 4.4-13.2 lb at 5.315 in, spring scale on the arm; S-002 p.10A-11 gives the same as 2-6 kg (4.4-13.2 lb) and says replace the bushes if it is out of range

specs.item: Torque, adjusting cover lock nut
specs.note: 51-72 ft-lb; 1985 gear (FA54-32-110), the cover that sets worm preload after the end cover; not printed in S-038, which gives only the end cover lock nut

specs.item: Steering column shaft joints
specs.note: 1985 specification table: gear type ball nut, shaft type regular (collapsible), shaft joint type 1 joint

specs.item: Special tool, worm preload attachment
specs.note: fits the column shaft end for a spring-scale pull; p.10A-10 prints 49 0180 510A

specs.item: Torque, side cover attaching bolts
specs.note: 33-40 ft-lb; sealing agent on the side cover; screw the sector shaft assembly in counter-clockwise before tightening

specs.item: Special tool, pitman arm puller
specs.note: also p.10A-12; the centre link is pulled off the pitman arm with 49 0118 850C

specs.item: Special tool, ball joint puller
specs.note: used at the pitman arm, idler arm and both tie-rod joints of the centre link (p.10A-12)

specs.item: Idler arm bush grease
specs.note: fill bush and spindle and pack the bracket on assembly; new split pin on the spindle nut

specs.item: Special tool, dust seal (boot) installer
specs.note: pack a small amount of lithium base NLGI No. 2 grease into the seal before fitting; the ball joints themselves are sealed and need no lubrication service (p.10A-10)

specs.item: Replacement Atkins Rotary 2113-32-365: thread and length
specs.note: Atkins lists the maker as Mazda, 19.95 USD, in stock; nuts 9992-21-400 (inside) and 9994-41-400 (outside)

specs.item: Replacement XRF Chassis ES2192R: inner tie rod end, 1979-85 RX-7
specs.note: two per car; the XRF page lists ES2192R as the inner end for 1979-85, 27.20 USD, and names no Moog part; the outer is ES2355 (eBay product page); confirm the maker and the part before buying

specs.item: Replacement Moog ES2355: outer tie rod end, 1979-85 RX-7
specs.note: two per car; outer (knuckle-arm) end, 1979-85 RX-7 per the eBay product page; inner is ES2192R; Moog's own listing could not be fetched (403)

specs.item: Replacement Moog K9369: idler arm, 1979-85 RX-7
specs.note: Moog idler arm; the forum post (factory 8871-32-320A NLA) says it is still listed on the Moog site but has not been available for over a year, and that RockAuto no longer carries the arm or the bushing

terminals.inside: Pressing the pad closes the horn contact set (8871-32-750, S-005 EC-093) between the GL wire and the column; it carries only the relay coil current
terminals.to: F-16 horn relay coil, via the E-01 column connector; the other side of the contact is column/body ground
terminals.note: from S-001 and the horn write-up (factory-circuits/horn.md); confirm on the car
